A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CADFusion study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material across appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original text-to-CAD experiments, baseline comparisons, ablations, human evaluations and qualitative failure analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and reports corrected Chamfer Distance measurements.

M1.justification: The LLaMA-based backbone, stringified CAD representation, cross-entropy and DPO objectives, visual preference construction and alternating training procedure are unchanged. The new prompting guidelines document usage without establishing a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same DeepCAD/SkexGen-derived text-to-CAD coverage, including the larger-data experiment and complex-shape examples. Appendix A's new prompting guidance reuses an existing example without adding an evaluated scenario.

E2.justification: The comparisons retain GPT-4o, Text2CAD and the same CADFusion variants. Text2CAD's expert, intermediate and authors' prompt settings, the GPT few-shot comparison and the RPO comparator were already present in v1.

E3.justification: v3 Appendix E reports correcting Chamfer Distance from a distribution-level calculation to a pairwise calculation. This changes one evaluation measure; the reported data splits, training settings and remaining evaluation procedures are retained.

E4.justification: The visual-feedback, alternating-training, annotation-quality, dataset-size and prompt-sensitivity analyses retain the same questions and experimental variants. Diversity examples and failure cases also remain unchanged; Table 3's numerical correction is covered under E6.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-training-run uncertainty, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. v3 explains averaging human ranks, but this documents the average-rank metric already reported in v1.

E6.justification: In Table 1, GPT-4o's CD changes from 85.04 to 68.50 and CADFusion's from 45.67 to 19.89; Table 3 repeats the CADFusion correction. CADFusion consequently moves below Text2CAD's unchanged 30.23 on this lower-is-better metric. These are revised measurements, not same-protocol performance gains; other reported results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix E newly asserts that the former distribution-level CD upper-bounds the pairwise measure. This is a limited added mathematical property claim without a derivation or proof. The CAD definitions and training equations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain combining sequential and visual supervision, alternating their training stages, constructing two datasets and demonstrating improved CAD generation. Removing 'significantly' from the abstract does not materially change these claims.

C2.justification: Appendix E newly interprets the CD correction as remedying an underestimate of performance without undermining the conclusions. Existing limitations concerning single-view feedback, complex shapes, evaluator bias and mismatched Text2CAD prompts remain; the prompt mismatch also gains a main-text reminder.

D1.justification: v3 supplies a code-repository link, adds structured prompting guidance in Appendix A, and specifies human judges' educational background and rank averaging in Appendix D.2. Existing hyperparameters, hardware, training duration and operational prompts are retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Seff et al.'s Vitruvion and explicitly distinguishes CADFusion's stringified LLM representation from codebook encoders such as VQ-VAE. Most other reference edits update publication information for already cited works.

P1.justification: v3 adds prompting guidance, acknowledgements, an ethics statement and a change log, alongside limited wording and publication-header edits. Existing appendices shift from A–C to B–D while retaining their organization. Several textual references to prompt listings fail to follow the new numbering.

P2.justification: The same eleven figures and five tables retain their designs and qualitative examples. A new prompt listing and page reflow alter placement, including moving Table 3 alongside Tables 4–5 and keeping previously split prompt listings together.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reporting by correcting and acknowledging the CD calculation error in Tables 1 and 3, adding code-access information and prompting guidance, and clarifying human evaluation. These are useful, bounded gains. Stale listing references slightly impair navigation, while the existing Text2CAD prompt mismatch remains unresolved; the lower CD values do not establish an improved model.
